title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: claim admission limits, desk authority and annual aggregate by tier
content:
## Scope

This table belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line and gives, for every tier, who may lodge a claim, the smallest claimed amount the product pays, the maximum number of claims on one cover, the desk's settlement authority and the annual aggregate limit.

## Tier table

| Tier | Who may lodge a claim | Smallest claimed amount paid | Maximum claims on one cover | Largest settlement the desk may approve | Annual aggregate limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability | cover holder, named consignee | 100.00 USD | 2 | 5000.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| AHL Declared Value Liability | cover holder, named consignee | 100.00 USD | 2 | 5000.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| AHL CargoCare Essential | cover holder only | 250.00 USD | 2 | 10000.00 USD | 150000.00 USD |
| AHL CargoCare Plus | cover holder, named consignee | 150.00 USD | 3 | 15000.00 USD | 300000.00 USD |
| AHL CargoCare Premium | cover holder, named consignee | 100.00 USD | 3 | 25000.00 USD | 750000.00 USD |
| AHL CargoCare Total | cover holder, named consignee | 50.00 USD | 5 | 50000.00 USD | 2000000.00 USD |

## Definitions

- **Who may lodge a claim**: the cover holder and, where listed, the consignee named on the transport document.
- **Smallest claimed amount paid**: the smallest claimed amount the product pays, per claim.
- **Maximum claims on one cover**: the maximum number of claims lodged on one cover, withdrawn claims excluded.
- **Largest settlement the desk may approve**: the desk's settlement authority, per claim.
- **Annual aggregate limit**: the annual aggregate limit of approved settlements; a figure of 0.00 means the tier carries no aggregate.

## Basis Q&A

**May the named consignee lodge a claim under AHL CargoCare Essential?** No; only the cover holder may lodge on that tier.

**Does AHL Declared Value Liability carry an annual aggregate?** No; its limit is 0.00, which means no aggregate.

**How many claims may one AHL CargoCare Total cover take?** Up to 5, withdrawn claims excluded.
